study.description: Social network of fourth grade girls
study.context: Rich neighborhood with competitive academic culture. Chinese and Indian mothers especially known for hiring tutors and sending kids to cram schools. These two demographics are socially salient to both parents and girls.

Bell.notes: Nicest teacher according to the girls

Gryser.notes: Strictest teacher according to the girls. Gryser is Park's mom (Park is a first grade boy). Boys and girls talk to each other in this class, which reportedly doesn't happen in other homerooms.

Bareres.notes: Per Ada: Bareres girls 'aren't really involved' — 'just people who are at recess.' Deprioritize for interviews.

subjects.name: Olivia Q
subjects.notes: One of 'the Chinese girls' / 'random Chinese girls'. Last initial Q distinguishes from Olivia N.

subjects.name: Milan
subjects.notes: One of the 'random Chinese girls' in Ashley's group.

subjects.name: Ellie
subjects.notes: One of the 'random Chinese girls' in Ashley's group. Last name possibly Greyser-adjacent or coincidence with homeroom.

subjects.name: Kaisha
subjects.notes: Paired with Navya in diagram. Ada admires Kaisha.

subjects.name: Lou
subjects.notes: New girl from the UK. Ada pronounces as 'Lao' in speech.

subjects.name: Maperi
subjects.notes: Turkish background, 'doesn't know English that well but speaks English instead of Turkish.' Described as 'silly.' Hangs out with Indian kids in Babu's class. Non-Indian girl embedded in Indian girls' group (like Lou before her).

subjects.name: Ruby
subjects.notes: NEW (Ada remarks). Lou's best friend per Ada. Also friends with Lyla. Unknown homeroom — Ada unsure which class Ruby is in.

subjects.name: Margaret
subjects.notes: NEW (Ada remarks). Sits near Madeline and Jane at Johnson lunch table. Homeroom inferred from seating.

subjects.name: Abby
subjects.notes: NEW (Ada remarks). Sits near Madeline and Jane at Johnson lunch table. Homeroom inferred from seating.

subjects.name: Devon
subjects.notes: NEW (3/25). Top friends: Olivia and Julia. Madeline gossiped to Devon about Ada; Devon reported it back to Ada.

uncertain_names.name: Nia
uncertain_names.source: Ada remarks — 'Mia and Nia' when listing Lou's friends. Possibly verbal fumble (Mia repeated), or a new person. Low confidence.

notes: ~29 girls total (up from ~25). Ruby, Margaret, Abby added from Ada's remarks; Devon added from 3/25 update. Bareres and Gryser homerooms still undersampled. 'Olivia M' in user's clique description = Olivia N (confirmed typo). Johnson now has 6 girls (Ashley, Madeline H, Jane, Margaret, Abby, Devon).
